_about: Hand-maintained fixes to TEC register matching (pipeline/tec_match.py). 'match' forces a TEC project (its Project ID) onto a list of REPD IDs; an empty list confirms it is not in REPD. 'noMatch' stops a TEC project being matched to one REPD ID. Each entry gives a reason. An entry whose TEC project or REPD record has gone is skipped and flagged in the pipeline report.

match.reason: Well Street Paisley (49.9MW battery, Gate 2) is REPD 'Well Street - Battery Storage' (49.5MW). Same street name and capacity; the name score fell just short only because of 'Paisley'.
Monets Garden (57MW, Gate 2) is REPD 'Monets Garden Battery, Osbaldwick' (50MW). Distinctive name; capacity 88% of TEC.
North Kyle New Cumnock (212MW wind, Gate 2, built) is REPD 'North Kyle Energy Project' (205.8MW), near New Cumnock.
Inch Cape offshore platform (540MW) is one of two connections for REPD 'Inch Cape' (1,080MW).

noMatch.reason: Kilmarnock BESS (350MW) was matched to REPD 'Kilmarnock Battery Energy Storage System' (500MW), but TEC's 'Kilmarnock South Battery Storage' (500MW) fits that record exactly.
